content:
Below is a resume template for a fresh high school graduate with at least 12 placeholders represented by square brackets:

---

**[Name]**
**[Address]**
**[City, State ZIP Code]**
**(XXX) XXX-XXXX | [Email Address] | [LinkedIn Profile (or other professional network)]**

---

### **Objective**
To secure an entry-level position at [**Company Name**] where I can apply the skills and enthusiasm gained during my high school career to contribute to the team's success.

---

### **Education**

* **High School Diploma**, [**High School Name**], [**Graduation Date**]
	+ **GPA:** [GPA]
	+ **Relevant Courses:**
		- [Course 1 (e.g., Computer Science)]
		- [Course 2 (e.g., Business Management)]
		- [Course 3 (e.g., Advanced English)]

---

### **Extracurricular Activities & Achievements**

* **[Activity/Club Name]**, [**Position (if applicable)**], [**Duration**]
	+ Achievements/Responsibilities: [Brief Description of Achievements or Key Responsibilities]
* **Volunteer Work**, [**Organization Name**], [**Duration**]
	+ Contributions: [Brief Description of Contributions]

---

### **Skills**

* **Technical:**
	+ Proficient in [**Software/Application 1**], [**Software/Application 2**]
	+ Basic Knowledge of [**Programming Language/Tool**]
* **Soft Skills:**
	+ Team Collaboration
	+ Time Management
	+ [**Additional Soft Skill**]

---

### **Work Experience**
*(If any part-time, internship, or relevant work experience exists; otherwise, this section can be omitted or replaced with more relevant sections for a fresh graduate)*

* **[Job Title]**, [**Company Name**], [**Employment Dates**]
	+ Job Summary and Achievements: [Brief Summary]

---

### **References**

Available upon request. (Alternatively, list one with permission)
* **[Reference Name]**, [**Reference Title**], [**Reference Company**], (XXX) XXX-XXXX

---

### **Certifications/Awards (If Applicable)**

* **[Certification/Award Name]**, [**Issuing Body**], [**Date**]
	+ Brief Description: [Description of the Certification/Award]

---

**Total Placeholders Used:** 12

### **How to Fill the Placeholders:**

1. **[Name]**: Your Full Name
2. **[Address]**: Your Street Address
3. **[City, State ZIP Code]**: Your City, State, and ZIP Code
4. **(XXX) XXX-XXXX**: Your Phone Number
5. **[Email Address]**: Your Professional Email
6. **[LinkedIn Profile (or other professional network)]**: Link to Your Profile
7. **[Company Name]**: Desired Company for the Objective (Optional, can be generalized)
8. **[High School Name]**: Name of Your High School
9. **[Graduation Date]**: Date of High School Graduation
10. **[GPA]**: Your Grade Point Average (Optional)
11. **[Course 1, Course 2, Course 3]**: Relevant High School Courses
12. **[Activity/Club Name, Position (if applicable), Duration, Brief Description of Achievements or Key Responsibilities]**: Details of Your Extracurricular Activity
13. **[Organization Name], [Duration], [Contributions]**: Details of Your Volunteer Work
14. **[Software/Application 1, Software/Application 2, Programming Language/Tool, Additional Soft Skill]**: Your Technical and Soft Skills
15. **[Job Title, Company Name, Employment Dates, Brief Summary]**: (If Applicable) Details of Any Work Experience
16. **[Reference Name, Reference Title, Reference Company, (XXX) XXX-XXXX]**: (With Permission) Details of a Professional Reference
17. **[Certification/Award Name, Issuing Body, Date, Description]**: (If Applicable) Details of Any Certifications or Awards

---

**Example Filled Section for Clarity (Do not submit with placeholders filled in this explanatory format in an actual application):**

### **Example - Education (DO NOT SUBMIT LIKE THIS, FILL PLACEHOLDERS DIRECTLY)**

* **High School Diploma**, *Lincoln High School*, *June 2023*
	+ **GPA:** *3.8*
	+ **Relevant Courses:**
		- *Computer Programming*
		- *Business Fundamentals*
		- *Advanced Literature* 

**Actual Submission Should Look Like This (with your information directly in place of placeholders):**

### **Education**

* **High School Diploma**, Lincoln High School, June 2023
	+ **GPA:** 3.8
	+ **Relevant Courses:**
		- Computer Programming
		- Business Fundamentals
		- Advanced Literature
